Body weight is only an internal fictional design brief, not text in the image. Exact exercise poses: Barbell PUSH PRESS. Right frame stand tall, knees and hips extended, both arms extended overhead holding same bar above shoulders over midfoot, no second dip. Model: East Asian female, age 30s, tall slender frame, ordinary muscle bulk, fictional design mass 57kg. Outfit: teal tee and grey shorts, ordinary trainers, secure any long hair. Respect this model, use realistic facial variation.
